prompts.tier1_full: Single-edge notched tension specimen, 1 mm by 1 mm steel plate in plane strain, with a horizontal pre-crack from the left edge at mid-height of length 0.5 mm. Bottom edge fully fixed (u_x = u_y = 0). Top edge pulled vertically upward (u_y) by 0.006 mm. Material: Steel_bench_2D_PE catalog values (E ~ 210 GPa, nu = 0.3, Gc ~ 2.7 N/mm). Run 100 quasistatic steps. Measure mode-I crack propagation and load-displacement curve.
prompts.tier2_partial: steel SENT plate, mode-I tension, edge crack, pulled vertically until it cracks
prompts.tier3_figure_only: Reproduce the load-displacement curve and crack path of the single-edge notched tension benchmark from Miehe, Welschinger, Hofacker (CMAME 2010, doi:10.1016/j.cma.2010.04.011) Figure 6 — mode-I propagation in a steel-like material on a 1mm square plate with a 0.5mm horizontal edge crack at mid-height.
